(a) Definitions. Contractor Employees - The term “contractor employees,” as used in this solicitation and contract language, refers to employees of the prime contractor or its subcontractors, affiliates, consultants, or team members. Sexual Harassment - As defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, sexual harassment is a form of sex discrimination that violates Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. The Northwest Fisheries Science Center (NWFSC) Environmental Chemistry Program (ECP) requires a comprehensive multi-year service and support agreement for its AB SCIEX ExionLC AE liquid chromatographer coupled with QTRAP 5500 tandem mass spectrometer (LC-MS/MS) systems. The requirement comprises one base year and 3 subsequent option years to ensure uninterrupted operational capacity. The service contract must include, at minimum: 1. Preventative Maintenance (PM): The PM has to be conducted by AB Sciex certified field engineers to ensure the system operates within Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications. One annual on-site visit for both LC and MS systems. Replacements of parts with OEM parts. 2. Corrective Repair: Unlimited on-site repairs conducted by AB Sciex certified field engineers to assure instrument returns to its peak performance and OEM specifications. On-site repair within 2 business days from the call for LC systems and 3 business days for MS systems. All service repairs will be performed by AB SCIEX’s certified field engineer. 3. f_Work.docx ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) RFID Cabinet The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires the acquisition of a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) storage cabinet integrated with Unique Device Identifier (UDI)-compliant tissue and implant tracking software to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, and efficient inventory management. Tracking tissues, biologics, and implantable medical devices is a federal regulatory requirement under FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI) and is critical to patient safety. VA healthcare facilities face ongoing resource challenges including staff shortages and budget constraints, making it essential to minimize staff time consumed by manual data entry and to maintain precise control over high-value inventory. This acquisition will provide an automated, real-time RFID-based inventory management solution for use in the operating room (OR), Catheterization (Cath) lab, ambulatory surgery center, or any facility location that stores high-value implantable inventory. Description The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires one (1) InVita UDTracker® RFID Cabinet — consisting of Terso Solutions RFID cabinet hardware integrated with InVita's UDTracker® tissue and implant
